column4: The same small porcelain maid doll as in the references (long orange hair, orange flower ornament, black dress with white apron, white boots, ball joints), full body, now standing up and stepping forward toward the viewer: one white boot stepping down and forward, the other foot behind, both hands lightly raised at her sides as if she just let go of a ledge, eyes open and curious, a faint smile. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; clean closed outline, no strings, no floor, no shadow, no text.
